Where Volkswagen sells the Passat and the Golf

Updated 2026-06-30. The Golf sells mainly in Europe (about 60 percent of 2024 volume), followed by China and North America (the Golf GTI and R only in the US since 2021). The Passat sells mainly in China (Magotan) and Europe; the US Passat was discontinued after the 2022 model year.
